headline: Taiwan's stock market has overtaken South Korea's as the world's best-performing major market as the AI trade spreads.
score_reason: Bloomberg market data read through a syndicated copy; dated 7 Oct 2026, no reduction.
importance_line: Fund managers and savers with Asia exposure see the AI rally shifting from memory-chip makers to the wider chip supply chain, though a new memory slump or a reversal in AI demand could change this.
summary: Bloomberg reports, in a version carried by The Business Times, that Taiwan's Taiex index is up 72% in 2026, making it the top performer among more than 90 indices Bloomberg tracks, ahead of South Korea's Kospi at about 65%. Taiwan beat Korea by about 23 percentage points last quarter, the widest gap since 2000, as shares of Samsung and SK Hynix fell 19% to 33%, and strategists favour Taiwan because its AI earnings come from sales volume rather than memory prices.
notes: Original Bloomberg link given; text read on Business Times (businesstimes.com.sg).
